behavior: Small atlas updates whose padded pixels plus frame buffers fit4 MiB remain in the ordinary mixed frame submission. Larger combined plans submit atlas rows in at most4 MiB padded chunks using the shared explicit builder and existing host16 MiB/process64 MiB/global-GPU512 MiB admission. Numeric caps are unchanged.

Pending glyph uploads retain a submitted row offset. Offset/counters advance only after successful admission and actual submission; batch and page accounting remain held until completion. Completed CPU glyph payloads leave the pending list.

Explicit continuation preserves successful text preparation and pending instance buffers while atlas chunks drain. On the final attempt, ordinary signatures recheck latest scene inputs; changed text updates instances. Failed preparation still invalidates/retries normally. No queued PreparedScene clone or native wait is introduced.

Prepare full-scene text before encoding or allocating frame queries, so an upload-only attempt cannot create a partial scene submission or numerical timing sample. Dialog-only rendering returns the same incomplete-frame result as full-scene rendering. Existing native adapters retain damage and resume through their queue receipt.

Opt-in cold measurement receipts remain explicitly incomplete under one frame identity across submissions. Complete cold timestamp/span attribution is still required; small/warm frame timing remains available.
